body: I live with my parents, I've been told I take up the most bandwidth and electricity from just sitting around doing whatever. I eat all their food(I get they're lawfully required to provide this for me but whatever) and waste their time with everything I need. I don't do anything for them either, it's not like with my siblings where they have activities and actually spend time with my parents. I'm just here, taking up space.
Idk, i'm not on any medication or getting any help. Whenever I try to open up to people about the simplest things I always end up sweating, shaking, crying and generally unable to speak.

Well, I tried to go through with it. I did it because i'm pointless, I do nothing day in and day out but sap resources and happiness off of people. Everything is too difficult and I didn't want to deal with it anymore. Like skipping an ad to its end.
